class.name: AssetTagRuntime
class.brief_description: Runtime helpers for reading and baking asset tags outside the editor.
class.description: Provides static APIs to read cached project tag assignments at runtime and to bake per-asset tag sidecars into an export output directory.

method.name: bake_tags_for_export
method.description: Writes per-asset tag sidecar JSON files under [param export_output_dir]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the bake fails.

method.name: invalidate_cache
method.description: Clears the in-memory runtime tag index cache so the next read reloads from disk.

method.name: notify_sidecar_dirty
method.description: Marks dirty sidecars for merge into the runtime cache on the next read.

method.name: read_tags_for_asset
method.description: Returns the cached tags assigned to the project asset at [param path].

method.name: read_tags_for_export_bake
method.description: Reads baked tags for [param path] from sidecars under [param export_output_dir].
